scope: Physical application catalog validation and snapshot helper transport; no production installation operations.

provenance.note: The containing commit identifies the reviewed implementation. These observations do not certify a later CI run or a future final commit.

contract.inspection: SQLAlchemy physical catalog against runtime Base.metadata
contract.application_tables: Exact table set within the modeled application schemas; alembic_version is the sole permitted extra table in the default schema.
contract.columns: Exact physical column names for every modeled table; missing or extra columns fail.
contract.foreign_keys: Exact grouped physical foreign key relationships, including composite mappings and referential actions.
contract.helper_transport: Verifier and guard bytes are both verified by SHA-256 before snapshot execution; stdin transport uses a fresh temporary directory.

coverage: Normal runtime contract and unchanged data
Missing, extra or divergent foreign key
Constraint name and database type spelling independence
Full installed metadata and snapshot rejection of an extra physical column

complete_scripts_tests.observation_source: Root agent host execution reported to the automation agent

real_postgresql_catalog.environment: Disposable isolated Core API PostgreSQL database
real_postgresql_catalog.observation_source: Root agent real PostgreSQL inspection reported to the automation agent
